puffish_attributes_empty_modifier_fast_p.conversion: Cancellable @Inject at the HEAD of DynamicModificationImpl.applyTo(double): when no entry has an ADDITION, MULTIPLY_BASE or MULTIPLY_TOTAL modifier (each instance's modifier map read first through the accessor PuffishModifierMapAccessor, a modifier there ends the test; then the three operation sets through the mod's own invoker, what its passes read) the answer is the sanitizeValue chain alone, the value the original's four passes compute then; otherwise the original. Entries with a null instance are skipped as the passes skip them. Trade-off (off by default): same results, but against the mod's own class (each path in its own JVM) a stealth check of a target with a modifier runs 0.963x (the six-attribute hook with one modifier 1.000x), while modifier-free hooks run 1.06-1.37x faster. Runtime flag puffishAttributesEmptyModifierFastPath. Helper bons.furious.patch.puffishattributes_coo49.PuffishLean.
